q1: SELECT beer.name, min_price, bar FROM beer LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT beer, MIN(price) AS min_price FROM serves GROUP BY beer) AS t ON beer.name = t.beer LEFT OUTER JOIN serves ON beer.name = serves.beer AND min_price = serves.price
q2: SELECT beer.name AS beer, MIN(s.price) AS price, CASE WHEN NOT MIN(s.price) IS NULL THEN GROUP_CONCAT(bar.name, ', ') ELSE NULL END AS bar FROM beer LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON beer.name = s.beer LEFT JOIN bar ON s.bar = bar.name GROUP BY beer.name ORDER BY beer.name
